sentences.text:
It is submitted that with the closing of FIR No.477/2023 by way of the settlement, the present FIR i.e.,
FIR No.600/2025 would also be closed.
4. It is noticed however that the complainant has not been made party to the present petition.
Accordingly, on oral prayer, the complainant is impleaded as a party-respondent in the matter.
Let amended memo of parties be filed before the next date.
5. The petitioner and complainant have joined via video-conferencing.
6. Learned counsel is also present on behalf of the complainant; and confirms that the disputes in FIR No.477/2023 have been settled and the parties would be moving for quashing of the said FIR.
7. Issue notice.
8. Mr. Nawal Kishore Jha, learned APP appears on behalf of the State on advance copy; and accepts notice.
9. Re-notify on 25th May 2026.

till the next date of hearing before this court.
